necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This service addresses the specific clinical need to evaluate these cardiac conditions as documented in the indication note.
